notes:
## 2.6.3 hotfix

- Fixed a replay recorder regression that could make players invisible to others when replay recording was enabled
- Removed the replay player bootstrap from normal gameplay while keeping replay recording available
- Kept the launcher platform-aware update flow introduced in 2.6.x

## Linux and Windows

- `BnlCommunityFixes.exe` is the Windows launcher
- `BnlCommunityFixes` is the Linux launcher
- On Linux, the launcher is native, but the game still launches through Steam/Proton
